name: Kamino Finance

requiredConfig.name: RPC connection
requiredConfig.description: Mainnet RPC the bridge or browser planner uses to query Kamino state. Cluster mismatches must be rejected with safety.action_not_exposed.

readCapabilities.returns: Per-reserve supplied positions for the connected wallet with earned interest.
Reserve-level state: supply APY, borrow APY, utilization, deposit cap remaining, withdraw availability, withdrawal delay seconds.
Deterministic earnings payload the user can sign through solana_sign_message to create a verifiable proof. No transaction is built.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures reserve, amount, supply APY, and deposit cap remaining. No transaction is signed at prepare time.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Kamino deposit transaction built at execute time, with refreshed reserve snapshot and a fee-payer set to the connected wallet.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures reserve, amount, withdrawal delay, and withdraw availability.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Kamino withdraw transaction built at execute time. Withdrawal delays vary per reserve and must be surfaced.

requiredUserInputs.name: amount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much do you want to deposit or withdraw?

requiredUserInputs.name: token
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Kamino reserve do you want to use?

requiredUserInputs.name: dueAt
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Should this action wait until a specific time before becoming ready? (ISO 8601, optional)

requiredConnectorFacts: Reserve supply APY at prepare time
Deposit cap remaining for the chosen reserve
Withdraw availability and withdrawal delay seconds
Connected wallet's SOL balance for fee headroom
Connected wallet's token balance for the chosen reserve
unsupportedRequests: Claim rewards on Kamino — the catalog lists 'Claim rewards' as a supported action but no kamino_claim_rewards adapter exists yet. Treat as unsupported until a claim action kind ships.
Borrow against a Kamino position — only deposit and withdraw are exposed.
Deposit a token not in the known reserve list (SOL, USDC, JitoSOL, mSOL, bSOL) without an explicit reserve mint address.
Operate on any cluster other than mainnet-beta.
actionPreparationNotes: Resolve the reserve symbol from token input via resolveKnownReserve; if absent, require reserveMint. Read a fresh reserve snapshot at prepare time and store reserveAddress, decimals, supplyApy, utilization, depositLimit, and withdrawAvailable in params. The execute path re-reads the snapshot and refuses if the wallet address has changed.
riskNotes: Withdrawals can be delayed by per-reserve withdrawalDelaySec. Deposits can be capped by depositLimitRemaining. Both must be surfaced in the review card before approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: Reads return facts without wallet involvement. Deposits and withdrawals build a transaction at execute time that the wallet must sign and broadcast. The agent never signs.

requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Kamino SOL deposit of 0.1 with the current supply APY and deposit cap. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.
Prepared a Kamino USDC supply of 25 against the USDC reserve. The wallet still controls approval.

needsInputQuestions: How much do you want to lend?
Which token (SOL, USDC, JitoSOL, mSOL, or bSOL)?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Tell me the amount and token and I will prepare the deposit.

requests.user: withdraw half my SOL from Kamino
needsInputQuestions: Should I read your current Kamino SOL position so 'half' resolves to a concrete amount?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. I can read your Kamino SOL position with solana_kamino_get_positions and confirm the exact amount before preparing.

requests.user: show my Kamino positions and earned interest
requests.agentResponse: Read your Kamino positions and per-reserve earned interest. The connector can read facts, but the wallet still controls approval.

requests.user: what's the current Kamino SOL supply APY?
requests.agentResponse: Read the SOL reserve snapshot and reported supply APY, utilization, and deposit cap remaining.

requests.user: prepare an earnings proof for my Kamino USDC reserve
requests.agentResponse: Built a deterministic earnings payload for your USDC reserve range. Sign with solana_sign_message to produce a shareable proof. This is read-only; no transaction is built.

requests.user: redeem 0.05 SOL from Kamino for manual approval
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Kamino SOL withdraw of 0.05. Withdrawal delay for SOL is included in the review card. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

The agent denied this because BONK is not a known Kamino reserve. Supported reserves are SOL, USDC, JitoSOL, mSOL, and bSOL; pass a reserveMint to override.

requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Kamino is only supported on mainnet-beta. Switch the active cluster before preparing.

needsInputQuestions: Should I check your wallet balance and the SOL reserve deposit cap before preparing?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. 100 SOL likely exceeds your balance or the reserve deposit cap; let me read facts before preparing.

requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because this connector is not enabled. Enable Kamino in Protocol Connectors before continuing.
